attacks.name: Shadow Bolt
steps: |!failure| |*Sap Power|: Before |!damage| is dealt, the defender loses 1 |!power| for each |!failure| in the attack roll, and this character gains that amount of |!power|.
|!failure| |*Hex|: After this attack is resolved, the defender gains the |§hex§Hex| special condition.

attacks.name: Incantation of Obliteration
steps: |!critical| |!wild| |!hit| |!failure| |*Dark Miasma|: After this attack is resolved, this character may make an additional |*Incantation of Obliteration| attack without paying the |!power| cost. The additional attack must target a character within |!range| 2 of the defender that has not been targeted by |*Incantation of Obliteration| this Round.

superPowers.name: Flames of the Faltine (Affiliation: Dark Dimension)
superPowers.body: If |*Dormammu| is included in a Squad, that Squad is affiliated with |*Dark Dimension| and must use this |!leadership|. This character and each other character you control gains 1 additional |!power| during the |*Power Phase|. During the |*Cleanup Phase|, if another allied character has 5 or more |!power|, it suffers 1 |!damage|.

superPowers.name: Not of This Dimension
superPowers.body: Place this character within |!range| 2 of its current position. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Feel the Power of Darkness!
superPowers.body: After an attack targeting this character is resolved, it may use this superpower. The attacking character gains the |§hex§Hex| special condition and is Pushed Away from this character |!range_small|. If the attacking character already had the Hex special condition, it gains the |§incinerate§Incinerate| special condition.

superPowers.name: Master of the Realm of Darkness
superPowers.body: When this character suffers |!damage| from an enemy effect, it gains 1 |!power| instead of |!power| equal to the |!damage| suffered. When another allied character is damaged by an enemy effect or by |*Flames of the Faltine|, this character gains 1 |!power|.|\|Additionally, when attacking, at the end of the |*Modify Dice| step, add 1 |!failure| result to this character's roll for each |!failure| in the defense roll. When attacking, this character adds |!failure| results in its roll to its total successes.

erratas.body: Shadow Bolt's special rules now trigger on |!failure| instead of |!wild|.
Dark Miasma special rule now triggers on |!critical| |!wild| |!hit| |!failure| rather than |!critical| |!hit| |!block| |!failure|.
Flames of the Faltine's |!power| check to damage allied characters now triggers during the Cleanup Phase rather than the Power Phase.
Master of the Realm of Darkness reworked so that |!failure| results are added to the attack roll instead of counting opposing |!failure| resuilts as successes.
